title: Agent Onboarding Kit
competency: 01. Toolchain Setup - Project rules, hooks, guardrails, and CLI or MCP wiring
mission: Create onboarding instructions that help a coding agent understand the repository, make correct code changes, and run the required checks without human guidance.
domain: Internal support case router where undocumented architecture, mixed patterns, hidden ownership decisions, and scattered verification expectations produce inconsistent agent PRs.
outcome: Before-and-after evidence and an independent reviewer task show whether concise repository onboarding helps fresh agents produce correct, focused, maintainable, and verified changes.
seededDefects: The repository has no agent rules or architecture map.
Existing patterns do not clearly identify the correct implementation boundary.
Related interface behavior can drift when changes are made in isolation.
Testing and review expectations must be discovered across scripts, source, and sparse notes.
verificationGates: AGENTS.md provides concise safe-start guidance and links every participant-created supporting document.
Integrity verification prevents changes to the challenge instructions, contracts, fixtures, and verification scripts.
Both agent-run branches start from the same application commit.
Before and after sessions use the same feature request and working conditions.
The final Needs Attention behavior is internally consistent and respects the discovered architecture.
The implementation-only check can measure the feature result on either branch.
Evidence includes both patches, session results, comparison, and passing checks.
The verify:exercise command checks application quality and exercise completion in one step.
The onboarding is reusable for a different reviewer-assigned feature without being rewritten.
agentWorkflow: Create two branches from the same commit and run the feature request without onboarding in the first branch.
Inspect package scripts, source folders, services, data, and docs before writing rules.
Create concise, reusable AGENTS.md guidance and any supporting documents justified by the repository in the second branch.
Run the same feature request in a fresh session on the second branch without retries or human correction.
Raise the final PR from the second branch with evidence from both runs.
Allow a reviewer to test the unchanged onboarding with a different repository task.
Capture comparable before and after results using the conditions defined in the exercise README.
workingDeliverables: AGENTS.md and any participant-selected supporting documents
